entries.name: Traumatic brain injury
entries.definition: Damage to the brain caused by an external force such as a blow, fall or blast, ranging from mild concussion to severe injury.

entries.name: Travel coordination
entries.definition: Arranging travel for other people, such as bookings, itineraries, visas and expense handling.

entries.name: Treatment planning
entries.definition: Setting out the goals, interventions and schedule of care for a patient or client based on an assessment.

entries.name: Treemap
entries.definition: A chart that shows hierarchical data as nested rectangles whose areas are proportional to their values.

entries.name: Trendline
entries.definition: A line added to a chart to show the general direction of a data series, often fitted by regression or a moving average.

entries.name: TV production
entries.definition: Planning, shooting and editing television programmes.

entries.name: Twisted pair
entries.definition: A cable type in which pairs of insulated copper wires are twisted together to reduce interference, used for telephone and Ethernet connections.

entries.name: Twitch
entries.definition: A live-streaming service, mainly for video games, where broadcasters stream to viewers and chat with them.

entries.name: Twitter advertising
entries.definition: Creating, running and measuring paid advertising campaigns on Twitter, now called X.

entries.name: Twitter marketing
entries.definition: Promoting a brand, product or cause on Twitter, now called X, through posts, engagement and community building.

entries.name: Typography
entries.definition: Choosing and arranging typefaces, sizes, spacing and layout so that written text is readable and visually effective.

entries.name: Ubersuggest
entries.definition: An online keyword research and SEO analysis tool.

entries.name: UglifyJS
entries.definition: A JavaScript parser, minifier and compressor toolkit used to make scripts smaller for deployment.

entries.name: UI patterns
entries.definition: Reusable, proven solutions to common user-interface design problems, such as navigation, forms and search.

entries.name: UIKit
entries.definition: Apple's framework for building and managing the graphical interface and event handling of iOS, iPadOS and tvOS apps.

entries.name: UIkit (web framework)
entries.definition: A lightweight, modular front-end framework for building web interfaces from ready-made HTML, CSS and JavaScript components, made by YOOtheme.

entries.name: UiPath
entries.definition: A robotic process automation (RPA) platform for building software robots that automate repetitive tasks on computers.

entries.name: UltraTax CS
entries.definition: Thomson Reuters software that accounting firms use to prepare tax returns.

entries.name: Ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy
entries.definition: An analytical technique that measures how much a sample absorbs light in the ultraviolet and visible range, used to identify or measure substances.

entries.name: Unbounce
entries.definition: An online platform for building, publishing and testing landing pages without writing code.

entries.name: Underscore.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library that provides utility functions for working with collections, arrays, objects and functions.

entries.name: Unified endpoint management
entries.definition: Managing and securing all of an organisation's endpoint devices, such as laptops, phones and tablets, from a single console.

entries.name: Unisys MAPPER
entries.definition: A Unisys reporting and application development system for building database reports and applications, mainly on mainframes.
variants: MAintain Prepare And Produce Executive Reports (MAPPER)
MAintain, Prepare, And Produce Executive Reports (MAPPER)

entries.name: Unity (game engine)
entries.definition: A cross-platform game engine and development environment for building real-time 2D, 3D, augmented-reality and virtual-reality applications.

entries.name: Unreal Editor
entries.definition: The editor application of the Unreal Engine, used to build levels and manage assets and gameplay content for games.

entries.name: Urban resilience
entries.definition: The capacity of cities and their systems to absorb, adapt to and recover from shocks and stresses such as disasters and climate change.

entries.name: Urban sustainability
entries.definition: Planning and running cities so that their economy, society and environment can be sustained over the long term.

entries.name: Urological disorders
entries.definition: The diseases and conditions of the urinary tract and male reproductive organs, such as kidney stones, infections and prostate problems.

entries.name: Usability testing
entries.definition: Evaluating how people use an interface to complete tasks.

entries.name: UsabilityHub
entries.definition: An online service for running remote usability and design feedback tests, such as first-click and five-second tests, with participants.

entries.name: Use case diagram
entries.definition: A UML diagram that shows the actors who use a system and the goals (use cases) the system supports.

entries.name: Use of force
entries.definition: The rules and techniques governing when and how much physical force a police officer, security guard or similar worker may lawfully use.

entries.name: User Datagram Protocol
entries.definition: A connectionless transport protocol of the Internet protocol suite, specified in RFC 768, that sends datagrams without guaranteeing delivery or order.

entries.name: User experience design
entries.definition: Designing interactions around user needs and usability.

entries.name: User interface design
entries.definition: Designing the visible controls and presentation of interactive software.

entries.name: User provisioning software
entries.definition: Software that automates creating, changing and removing user accounts and access rights across an organisation's systems.

entries.name: User research
entries.definition: Investigating user needs and behavior to inform design.

entries.name: Utility engineering
entries.definition: Engineering of the networks that deliver public utilities such as electricity, water, gas and telecommunications.

entries.name: Utility frequency
entries.definition: The standard frequency of alternating current in a country's power grid, usually 50 or 60 hertz.

entries.name: UX writing
entries.definition: Writing the words that appear in a digital product's interface, such as labels, buttons and error messages, so that people can use it easily.
